name: St. Regis Cap Cana
positioning: The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort, the brand's first resort in the Dominican Republic, set on a private beach at the southern end of the Cap Cana enclave and surrounded by the Punta Espada golf course
best_for: Golfers who want the Punta Espada course steps from the lobby
Couples who want a quiet beach resort with butler service
Families with children ages 4 to 12 who want a kids club

facts.text: The resort sits on the southern end of the Cap Cana resort enclave.
It is the St. Regis brand's first resort in the Dominican Republic.
The golf course is located just steps from the lobby.
Artworks by Dominican artists are displayed throughout the building.
Nina, the signature restaurant, is a collaboration with chef Diego Muñoz.
Cassava, the all-day restaurant, is inspired by Dominican and Latin Caribbean cuisine.
Cielo Mio, the rooftop bar, serves tiki-style drinks with a Mexican twist.
In the Amber Room, a cigar sommelier selects a cigar and a rummelier pairs it with rum.
The spa has separate men's and women's areas with indoor and outdoor lounges, hot and cold baths, steam rooms and saunas.
The kids club is designed for children ages 4 to 12.
Rooms have Frette sheets and robes.

highlights.text: The Jack Nicklaus Punta Espada golf course surrounds the resort.
The Amber Room cigar bar operates in partnership with Arturo Fuente.
The resort has a private beach.
Butlers are on call, including by WhatsApp, and can arrange tennis lessons, boat excursions and horseback riding.
Local design touches include tropical plants, patterned brickwork and curved ceilings with wickerwork typical of the island.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; Punta Cana airport (PUJ) is about 15 km away.
Tennis courts and a marina are a short drive away.
